# HouseMate Lite

http://schema.org/OutOfStock

Add to Referral

- Does not include Switch

Items may vary from Illustration. Limits apply. FlexEquip items are loaned or rented for short to medium-term use. The returned items are checked and cleaned according to a strict cleaning protocol by FlexEquip staff prior to subsequent loan or rental.

- Description

- Included

- Key Features

- Setting Up Links

- Additional Information

- A hand-held environmental control unit which can be used to control appliances such as the TV and produce recorded auditory playback.

- Included:

- Initial use batteries

- Direct touch or switch activated access

- Programmable scanning options

- Speech output with built in microphone and speakers.

- Demonstration on use of a HouseMate Lite: https://vimeo.com/64534468

- The user can record up to 20 infrared commands from other remote controls. Long sentences for playback command for voice activated systems can also be recorded. The user can select commands via direct touch or switch access.
